title: The Unlabeled Wall
prompt:
**Scenario.** A problem gives n ≤ 100000 intervals and asks for the largest set of pairwise non-overlapping ones. The statement mentions no algorithm. First move?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Try DP over all subsets

**B)** Model it (intervals, objective = max compatible set), note n ≤ 10^5 admits O(n log n), then hunt for the exchange-argument sort key

**C)** Brute force with pruning

**D)** Random restarts with different orders

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: The pipeline in action: model first, budget names O(n log n), the known structure (earliest-end exchange) falls out of the proof habit.
